products.name: Glove Box Latch & Handle
products.oemNote: Replaces OEM part 77540-S04-003ZA, discontinued by the manufacturer. Used units run ~$15 when they surface at all.
products.materialNote: Printed in PETG for impact resistance and interior heat tolerance. Layer orientation chosen so the latch spring tab loads along the strongest axis.
description: The glove box latch is the single most common interior failure point on this generation: the spring tab fatigues, the handle snaps, and the glove box either won't stay shut or won't open. The original part is no longer available new — this is a direct-fit replacement modeled from the original geometry.
Drop-in installation with the original screws. No trimming, no adapters.
features: Direct replacement for discontinued OEM part 77540-S04-003ZA
PETG construction, stronger than the original brittle ABS in the failure zone
Matte black finish to match the factory dash
products.installNote: Two screws from the glove box lid interior. 5–10 minutes with a Phillips screwdriver.

products.name: HVAC Slider Lever & Knob Set
products.fitment: Fits 1996–1998 Civic (EK/EJ chassis, manual climate control)
products.oemNote: Individual knobs were never sold separately — the only new option is a complete climate control unit that costs far more than a knob justifies. Used knobs are pick-a-part luck.
products.materialNote: PETG holds up to dash-top sun exposure that softens PLA. Sliders are dimensioned to the original track with a light friction fit.
description: Complete set of slider levers and knobs for the 96–98 manual climate control panel. These crack and go missing constantly, and there has never been a way to buy just the knob — until now.
Set includes all slider knobs for the manual HVAC panel. Press-fit onto the original lever arms.
features: Full knob set for the 96–98 manual climate control panel
Press-fit installation — no tools, no adhesive
PETG construction rated for dash-top sun exposure
Sold as a complete set; singles never existed even from the factory
products.installNote: Press onto the original lever arms by hand. Under a minute per knob.
keywords: EK Civic HVAC slider knob replacement

products.name: Interior Door Handle Bezel
products.oemNote: The original bezel is a documented weak point — the thin plastic around the handle cup cracks with age and door slams. New replacements are gone; the used market sells you the same 25-year-old brittle plastic.
products.materialNote: PETG with added wall thickness in the crack-prone corner radius — the one place the original design was under-built.
description: The surround that frames the interior door release handle. On this generation the original plastic goes brittle and cracks at the corner radius — a known issue documented across owner forums for years.
This reproduction keeps the original mounting and visual profile but thickens the section that fails. Sold per side.
features: Direct-fit reproduction of the discontinued interior handle bezel
Reinforced corner radius at the documented crack point
Available in left-hand and right-hand versions
products.installNote: Unclips from the door card around the release handle. Trim tool recommended.
keywords: EK Civic door handle trim cracked
